shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — verified cross-level combat (shot parity, one-map audio, tracers, weapon-aware one-map AI, high-ground bonuses, CE direct fire), multi-pawn cross-level orders, grouped sky drop-pod landings, wide stairs, elevators, pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref (foreign types in method bodies / object signatures only). ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B) — Source/Combat/
Projectile spawns on the TARGET's map; acquisition (LoF + range) and launch are custom; everything downstream vanilla/CE. Gated ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat.
- **Shot parity (ABShotEffects)**: full cast-pipeline side effects. Self-test 14/14.
- **One-map audio (ABCombatSoundContext)**: one-shot combat sounds audible across the paired level.
- **Tracers (ABCrossLevelTracers)**: bolt spanning both levels per direct shot. [StaticConstructorOnStartup].
- **LoF symmetry**: DOWN uses the same ExposedToGap leniency as UP.
- **Weapon-aware one-map AI (CrossLevelAutoEngage)**: 60t cadence. Hostiles engage nearest hostile-to-THEM across both levels (pawns-only distance gate). Friendlies (undrafted Attack colonists + ALLIED factions): ranged with a shot -> cross-fire; MELEE or no line of fire -> ROUTE across the stairs to the fight (TryRouteToEngage). Drafted colonists ride the overwatch event hook. JobDriver draft requirement lifted for auto-defense jobs. Immortal stairs excluded from HasReachableTarget so stuck hostiles descend/route instead of milling.
- **High-ground bonuses (upper shooter only, subtle)**: vanilla +10% aim (HighGroundAccuracyFactor 1.10 in ComputeAimChance); CE 12% tighter spread (HighGroundSpreadFactor 0.88); CE suppression on sky pawns x0.75 (ABCESuppressionPatch - manual Harmony prefix on CombatExtended.CompSuppressable.AddSuppression, resolved via TypeByName, vanilla-only signature, absent-safe).
- **Diagnostics**: CrossLevelCombat.ExplainCanFire (stage-by-stage rejection reason) + dev action "AB: cross-fire probe (selected pawn)" — logs guard/setting state, verb type/range/CE-ness, paired-level target list with per-target failing stage + reposition availability. FOR BUG1 (upper pawns stand idle with CE): run this probe on an idle upper pawn to identify the failing stage.

### COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT (ABCECompat + ABVerb) — BUILT; accuracy = REAL CE SPREAD
Pipeline widened to base Verb; ABVerb abstracts GetRangedVerb/ProjectileOf (vanilla or CE). Fire branches to FireCE: ProjectileCE spawned on target map, launched via CE TrajectoryWorker aimed AT the target, scattered by weapon ShotSpread x spreadMult + shooter SwayAmplitude (option B - CE ballistics decide the hit; no separate roll). PARITY ammo via CompAmmoUser (CanBeFiredNow/TryPrepareShot/Notify_ShotFired/Notify_PostShotFired). CE types confined to ABCECompat method bodies. Scope: direct fire; CE arc/mortars + CE turrets inert. OPEN BUG1: upper-level pawns stand IDLE with CE (not firing, not routing) — probe added to diagnose acquisition; suspect verb/geometry stage, awaiting probe output.

## CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS (CrossLevelOrders) — MULTI-PAWN SUPPORT ADDED 2026-07-23
Single-pawn: unchanged (float-menu redirect, virtual position + CurrentMap swap, stairs routing, below ghost drag). NEW multi-pawn branch (was the BUG2/BUG3 gap: ShouldRedirect required exactly 1 pawn; vanilla filters off-CurrentMap pawns in ShouldGenerateFloatMenuForPawn AND HandleMultiselectGoto, so group cross-level orders silently did nothing):
- ShouldRedirectMulti: >=2 spawned player colonists, all within the viewed/below pair, click resolves by the same open-air rule; any cross pairing triggers handling.
- HandleMultiOrder (drafted pawns only, vanilla multiselect-goto parity): ATTACK click -> each pawn engages (cross-gap fire when possible, else stairs RouteThenEngage). MOVE click, all pawns on the below target level -> multi-pawn press-preview-release ghost drag; otherwise immediate dispatch: formation spread via NextSpreadCell (shared radial-pattern allocator), same-level pawns PawnGotoAction, cross pawns stairs-route + replay goto on arrival (ABPendingOrders). One "no stairs" message max.
- ABBelowGotoDrag extended to N pawns (list, per-frame spread recompute, N ghosts + circles, release dispatches all + ColonistOrdered sound; cap 30).
- Prefix returns a SINGLE-pawn FloatMenuContext after handling so Selector's multiselect-goto fallback cannot double-order same-level pawns.

## SKY DROP-POD LANDING (ABSkyDropCells + ThreatDivert.IsSkyPodDrop) — VERIFIED 7/7
Pods land grouped on plateaus; sky-aimed pod raids exempt from the pocket redirect.

## SEE-BELOW / BASEMENTS / POD TRANSIT / HAULING / AUR — unchanged (plumb mirror; basementType SolidRock/Caverns/4 Alpha carve/UrbanRuins + reveal-on-load; skyfaller airspace transit; PUAH/HD bulk; AUR guard + facility stamp).

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs. Dev-tools: self-test suite + cross-fire probe.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. **Combat Extended: direct fire built (real-spread accuracy, parity ammo, high-ground spread+suppression bonuses); BUG1 (upper pawns idle) under diagnosis; arc/turrets inert.** Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **Multi-pawn cross-level orders BUILT** (BUG2/BUG3: root cause = single-pawn-only redirect + vanilla CurrentMap filters; now group attack/move with formation spread, stairs routing, and a multi-pawn below ghost drag). **BUG1 (upper pawns idle with CE) instrumented**: ExplainCanFire + "AB: cross-fire probe (selected pawn)" dev action logs the exact failing acquisition stage. High-ground bonuses + CE real-spread accuracy landed earlier today; Warg melee job-loop noted x1 (recoverable, plumb-coordinate melee edge; watch). PENDING TEST: multi-pawn orders (move/attack/ghost, both directions), BUG1 probe output on an idle upper pawn with CE, CE-absent palette safety run. Outstanding: CE arc/turrets, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.
